caption: The drawing features a single, prominent object at the top center of the page, which is rendered in color. This object is an ornamental, symmetrical piece with a yellow-gold base color and darker gold-brown shading to give it a three-dimensional look, along with a small blue swirl pattern on its surface. The object has rounded and curved shapes, with curled ends and small spherical knobs on either side. Below this colored ornament are three outline sketches of the same object, arranged in a triangular formation, with two near the upper middle and one centered below them. These three sketches are drawn in faint, thin lines without any color or shading, showing different angles or stages of the same form. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color.
title: Brooch
